answer: Like a pearl forming around grit, trust forms around a planted flaw: each epoch the network slips one subtly broken instruction into every agent's job, and only an agent truly doing the work spots and repairs it. A prism check re-runs the repair through three unrelated verifiers, and yarrow roots the result in the public ledger. Each fake needs its own live repair and posts a 4 POA bond doubling per extra identity, so the tenth clone risks 2,048 POA.
